title: The migration plan and receipt do not say what each carried 0.5.x file becomes
symptom: chough migrate's sources is a bare path-to-SHA-256 map; carried files name no target, and the receipt's Removed section says only carried into the 0.6.0 records above
trigger: chough migrate on any committed 0.5.0 project
expected: Each 0.5.x file with its SHA-256 and what it becomes (REQ-records-009, docs/cli.md)
actual: Only removed files say why; carried ones can be traced only by ID through aliases
environment: local-macos-arm64, tester clone at 367dc86b, debug build, SpecSync 6.2.0
impact: A reviewer cannot see where session.json or the EVT files went before consenting

notes.text: status: open -> investigating. Red at 57b88a8a (leif/0.6.0-test1-red: d854ce1a plus the regression tests): TC-records-migrate-plan-says-what-each-file-becomes failed, the plan has no becomes; fix in 2de0e7cd.
